policy: Installed Labs0.9.0 classify uses exact Mann-Whitney U on independent block medians: p<=alpha(.05) and abs(Hodges-Lehmann delta)>=minDelta(.05). Both retained comparison headers confirm alpha=.05/minDelta=5%.
p50Distinction: Reported p50 delta is a median ratio, not the Hodges-Lehmann estimator, so a 4.6% p50 row can still classify slower. Preserve actual p/CI/status and absolute values; do not force p50 into a 5% gate.
userPolicy: The user imposes no former1ms/5% admission floor. Full-row values and uncertainty remain visible, including Labs-neutral values; neutral does not establish parity or zero effect. No capture or library/harness policy changed.
